TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Delhi Traffic Police has made special traffic arrangements in view of the visit of dignitaries at Mahatma Gandhi Smriti Sthal, Rajghat.

Date: 05.03.2026
Time: 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM

📍 LIKELY AFFECTED POINTS
ITO Chowk, Delhi Gate, Guru Nanak Chowk, Shantivan Chowk, Rajghat DTC Depot and IP Flyover

📍 PUBLIC ADVISORY
-Prefer public transport to reduce congestion
-Park vehicles only at designated parking area
-Avoid roadside parking
-Those travelling to Airport/New Delhi Railway Station are advised to plan their journey in advance
-Commuters are advised to plan their journeys accordingly

📍 Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

Traffic Advisory – Bedford Highway – Wastewater System Maintenance

From 10:30 PM on Saturday, March 7, to 8:00 AM on Sunday, March 8, Halifax Water crews will be performing wastewater system maintenance on the Bedford Highway between Holland Avenue and Spring Street, Bedford.

There will be an altered center line and stop-and-go traffic within the work zone.

This work will not impact Halifax Water services in the area.
